plate_comment: The exhaust brake lockup aid (e2m RE_E_Brake_Inhibit_LU / RE_EB_Lockup_Range_* / RE_E_Brake_Inhibit_Timeout). The rising edge of the converter clutch solenoid request (logical output 18) sets bit 0 of exhaust_brake_lockup_flags, which holds the exhaust brake off (cm848_updateEngineRetarderEnableState reads it as lockup disengaged) until the converter locks. exhaust_brake_lockup_inhibit_timer counts down from exhaust_brake_lockup_inhibit_timeout (3 s). While the request is on and transmission_speed_ratio is inside the gear's window (exhaust_brake_lockup_speed_ratio_2nd / 3rd / 4th_gear_minimum / _maximum, around the gear ratios), bits 0 and 2 clear: lock confirmed, the exhaust brake may apply. In 1st they clear too. If the timer runs out first, it sets condition_eval bit 6 (the lockup inhibit / converter unlock request) and bit 2. Called at the end of cm848_selectGovernorPressureLockupBoost (was cm848_monitorConverterClutchEngagement, stage E's misreading; originally cm848_processProtectionRateLimitFlags) (was cm848_monitorConverterClutchEngagement) | earlier note: Confirms each converter clutch engagement. The rising edge of the converter clutch solenoid request (logical output 18) sets bit 0 of converter_clutch_transition_state (engagement pending), and converter_clutch_engagement_timer counts down from converter_clutch_engagement_time_limit (3 s). While the request is on and transmission_speed_ratio is inside the gear's locked window (transmission_2nd / 3rd / 4th_gear_locked_speed_ratio_minimum / _maximum, around the gear ratios: no converter slip), bits 0 and 2 clear: the engagement is confirmed. In 1st they clear too. If the timer runs out first, it sets the lockup inhibit (condition_eval bit 6) and bit 2 (engagement timed out), and bit 2 clears again when the inhibit clears (was cm848_processProtectionRateLimitFlags)

The 48RE lockup boost governor pressure mode (pressure state 0x10, e2m RE_Lockup_Boost 'Gov pressure target during lockup, to prevent downshift'): in 3rd / 4th outside transfer-case low range, with the lever not in 1 / 2 (transmission_selected_gear 0x7e / 0x7f), condition_eval bit 6 clear, transmission_overheat_protection_active_flag clear and switch 12 (the exhaust brake switch) off, while the throttle is below the lockup curve (the tables it shares with cm848_applyConverterLockupSchedule; once in the mode the second curve, held by load_condition_flags bit 2 = RE_High_Pressure), the target is governor_pressure_lockup_boost. The user override (governor_pressure_override_enable / _value, state 0x17) follows. With the lever in 1 / 2 and the output speed below transmission_manual_2nd_4_3_downshift_maximum_output_speed it requests the 4-3 downshift (condition_eval bit 1, clearing the 3-4 bit 2) unless overdrive_control_flags bit 3 is set. Ends with cm848_updateExhaustBrakeLockupInhibit (was cm848_selectGovernorPressureHighGear in stage E; originally cm848_calculateProtectionThresholdLimit) (was cm848_selectGovernorPressureHighGear) | earlier note: The 48RE high gear governor pressure mode (pressure state 0x10): in 3rd / 4th outside transfer-case low range, with the lever not in 1 / 2 (transmission_selected_gear 0x7e / 0x7f), lockup not inhibited (condition_eval bit 6), transmission_overheat_protection_active_flag clear and switch 12 off, while the throttle is below the output-speed curve (or the second curve once in the mode, held by load_condition_flags bit 2), the target is governor_pressure_high_gear_target. With the lever in 1 / 2 and the output speed below protection_derate_ramp_exit_threshold_cal it requests the 4-3 downshift (condition_eval bit 1, clearing the 3-4 bit 2) unless overdrive_control_flags bit 3 is set (was cm848_calculateProtectionThresholdLimit)
